_about: How scripts/build_model.py places the BodyParts3D meshes. Source units are mm with z up and -y to the front. Output is metres with y up and +z to the front: x' = x/1000 * scale * width(y'), y' = z/1000 * scale, z' = -y/1000 * scale + z_offset. width is linear between [height_m, factor] points.
